supporting_span: every individual (other than a surviving spouse as defined in section 2(a) or the head of a household as defined in section 2(b)) who is not a married individual (as defined in section 7703)
rule: (is_individual(individual) AND NOT is_surviving_spouse(individual) AND NOT is_head_of_household(individual) AND NOT is_married_individual(individual)) -> qualifies_for_unmarried_tax_schedule(individual)

supporting_span: 15% of taxable income if the taxable income is not over $22,100
$3,315, plus 28% of the excess over $22,100 if the taxable income is over $22,100 but not over $53,500
rule: (qualifies_for_unmarried_tax_schedule(individual) AND has_taxable_income(individual,taxable_income) AND amount_over(taxable_income,22100) AND amount_not_over(taxable_income,53500)) -> tax_amount_equals(individual,3315 + 0.28*(taxable_income - 22100))
